div.head: Ger 8[a]
div.ab: [8[a]] Æfre he mæig findan, on ðam he mæig nyt beon ⁊ ða nytte don, ðe him fylstan scylan;
Æfre he mæig findan on ðam he mæig nyt beon . 7 ða nytte don ðe him fylstan scylan .
Æfre he mæig findan, on ðam he mæig nyt beon, and ða nytte don ðe him fylstan scylan.
Immer kann er [der Vogt] entdecken, woran er nützlich sein und solche nützlichen Verrichtungen ausführen kann, welche ihm helfen werden;
He [the reeve] can always find out how he can be useful and carry out such useful tasks as will help him;
He must always discover that in [which] he may be useful, and make use of that which shall assist him.
He must always seek out that in which he might be helpful, and take advantage of anything he shall find useful.
div.note: Liebermann's 8 is split here into two rows. Liebermann compares Gerefa 13.
Rabin’s 8 covers the rows 8[a], 8[b]; it is given here, in the first.
